from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyProfit(BaseModel):
    """One company's profit metric as reported in its financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The securities/codes associated with the company, if mentioned")
    profit_metric: str | None = Field(description="The full name of the profit metric as written in the report")
    profit_amount: float | None = Field(description="The amount of profit; may be negative if a loss")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024 年第一季度'")
    report_section: str | None = Field(description="Where this data appears in the report, e.g., '主要会计数据和财务指标'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_profits: list[CompanyProfit]
